title: Fast melodic figure outlining a chord shape
purpose: forcing function for voice-leading. The interim classifier mis-classifies this as chord because the three attacks fall within CHORD_CLUSTER_WINDOW and the pitches form a chord template. Voice-leading-aware classification would correctly identify it as melody by tracking voice continuity.
expected_prose:
All three notes are melody.

**Expected (interim, combined rule):** state=chord, identity=(C, major),
confidence=declared. Known failure of the interim rule; deferred
to voice-leading work — see design doc "Deferred to future work" §1.
pending_reason: A C-E-G run played as fast sequential single notes — each pitch attacked 30ms apart, each note 50ms long, intended musically as a melody fragment.
